---

The badge says the data may be incomplete or stale. **It comes off when that stops being true, not
when the code feels finished.**

Those are genuinely different conditions, and conflating them is how a project ends up claiming
completeness it has not earned. The version bump and the badge removal belong in the same change
precisely so the question gets asked once, honestly: *is the data good enough that a visitor should
trust it without a warning?*

**References** — [LEGAL.md §4.7](../../docs/LEGAL.md)
